Claim 25 (Currently amended): A computer readable medium having __computer executable instructions for__ providing the electronic certificate selection information and associated recipient data to a merchant server; receiving, from the merchant server, electronic value certificate data derived from the certificate selection information; establishing a communications link with a mobile device corresponding to the recipient data; and provisioning the electronic value certificate data on the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications.

Claim 13 (Currently amended): A system for electronically providing an electronic value certificate to a mobile device, the system comprising: a merchant server for receiving certificate selection information related to the selection of an electronic value certificate and associated recipient data from a certificate selection device and generating electronic value certificate data; and an over the air (OTA) provisioning server for receiving the electronic value certificate selection data from the merchant server, establishing a communications link with a mobile device associated with recipient data, and provisioning the electronic value certificate data to the mobile device over the communications link via over the air (OTA) communications, wherein the electronic value certificate data includes __personalization data that is used to generate a softcard coupon in the mobile device__.
